flow: Exposed Humans (age a)->Infectious Humans (Symptomatic, age a)
Exposed Humans (age a)->Infectious Humans (Asymptomatic, age a)
Infectious Humans (Symptomatic, age a)->Recovered Humans (age a)
Infectious Humans (Asymptomatic, age a)->Recovered Humans (age a)
Infectious Humans (Asymptomatic, age a)->Infectious Humans (Symptomatic, age a)
param: a Host chronological age (structuring variable a in densities Sh(a,t), Eh(a,t), Ih(a,t), Ah(a,t), Rh(a,t))
B Influx (recruitment) rate of susceptible human population
μₕ Natural death rate of human hosts
βₕ(a) Age-dependent transmission/contact rate from infectious mosquitoes to susceptible humans (standard incidence term uses βₕ(a) Iᵥ Sh / Nh)
k(a) Age-dependent progression rate from exposed humans to infectious humans (end of latent period)
ρ Probability an exposed human becomes symptomatic infectious (0<ρ<1); fraction (1-ρ) becomes asymptomatic infectious
γ₁(a) Age-specific recovery rate of symptomatic infectious human hosts
γ₂(a) Age-specific recovery rate of asymptomatic infectious human hosts
σ Reinfection intensity factor: scales contact rate for reinfection of asymptomatic humans (σ βₕ(a))
μᵥ Natural death rate of mosquitoes
βᵥ(a) Age-specific transmission rate from infectious human hosts to susceptible mosquitoes
Nₕ(t) Total number of humans at time t (used in standard incidence terms)
P∞(a) Limiting age distribution used for normalization (Sh=sh P∞, etc.)
